ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.Category: Settings for the Object Explorer for MySQL extension.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.DebugLog: Write detailed diagnostics, such as executed metadata queries, to the Output window pane "Object Explorer for MySQL". Passwords are always masked.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.DragDrop: How object names are inserted when you drag them into an editor or copy them with Ctrl+C.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.SqlQuoti: When names dropped into a .sql file get backticks. "Only when needed" quotes reserved words, names with special characters and names that start with a digit.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.OtherQuo: When names dropped into other files (C#, VB and so on) or copied with Ctrl+C get backticks. With "Never" you get the plain name and can add your own quotes.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.Database: Database prefix for tables and views
Insert tables and views as database.table, for example sakila.actor.
Database prefix in procedure and function calls
Insert calls as CALL database.procedure(...) and SELECT database.function(...), so they work whatever database is active.
ObjectExplorerForMySql.Settings.ColumnSe: Separator between the names when you drag or copy several columns or a Columns folder.
